name: covenant-guard
description: Read-only MCP tools over covguard guarded runs: status, receipts, and signature verification.
long_description: Covenant Guard (covguard) runs a coding agent unattended with a hard spend cap, an OS sandbox, and a signed receipt. This MCP server exposes read-only tools over the local guard state: guard_status (latest run, spend against cap), guard_receipts (list runs), and guard_verify (re-check a receipt's ed25519 signature and SHA-256 event chain).
